mfa.title: Security
mfa.subtitle: Manage your two-factor authentication and account recovery options.
mfa.statusDescription: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. You will need a code from your mobile device to sign in.
mfa.recoveryCodesHint: Use these if you lose access to your authenticator app. Keep them in a safe place.
mfa.configureSubtitle: Follow these steps to link your mobile device to your Avarewase account.
mfa.scanQrCodeStep1Hint: Open your authenticator app and start setup to generate your QR code and secret key.
mfa.scanQrCodeStep2Hint: Open your authenticator app and scan the code below to add this account.
mfa.enterSetupKeyManually: Enter this setup key manually into your app instead.
mfa.verifyConnectionHint: Enter the 6-digit code generated by your app to confirm setup.
mfa.disableSubtitle: Enter your current 6-digit code to turn off two-factor authentication.
